restore environment (via Renv package)
```{r setup, include=FALSE}

if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("renv")
}

if (!renv::status()$synchronized) {
  renv::restore(prompt = FALSE)
}

```

```{r}

library(data.table)
setDTthreads(2)
library(stringdist)
library(UMIcountR)

```

extract sbRNA sequences from reads mapped to generic reference

```{r}

spike_reads <- extract_spike_dat("sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.filtered.Aligned.GeneTagged.UBcorrected.sorted.CB.bam", spikename = "generic_spike_3p", spikecontig = "generic_spike_3p",  match_seq_before_UMI = "TCCCTCACTGCAAA", match_seq_after_UMI = "CCGAGACAGGCTTTGAGT", spikeUMI_length = 14)

sbRNA_reads <- setnames(spike_reads, names(spike_reads), gsub("spikeUMI", "sbRNA_UMI", names(spike_reads)))

# fwrite(sbRNA_reads, "sbrna_droplet_scRNAseq.extracted.sbrna.dat.csv")

```
